_about: Presentation surface of wem_lint — report strings (MESSAGES) and the finding
catalogue (CATALOGUE), shared by every distribution's criterion.
§2.2 t.6): presentation is versioned apart from the criterion and is NOT part of
the D-10 reproducibility triple — a wording fix must not invalidate a conformance
snapshot, and copying 250 lines of prose into every distribution's criterion would
break DRY and guarantee drift. A criterion may still carry inline MESSAGES /
CATALOGUE; those win over this file (backwards compatible).
`en` is the default and the fallback and must stay complete, so a missing
translation degrades to UK English instead of printing a key.
_CATALOGUE: One entry per finding kind. `code` and `ref` are language-neutral;
`title`/`why`/`fix` sit under a language key. `code` identifies the KIND only —
severity is a `rules` fact of the criterion and is carried by the badge.

en.title: import loop — two modules import each other
why: Two modules import each other (directly or through a chain).
That is a loop: Python cannot load them cleanly, and every change
to one drags the other with it.
fix: Fix: break the loop — move the shared piece somewhere both sides
may import (a lower layer), so the arrows point one way only.

hr.title: petlja uvoza — dva modula uvoze jedan drugoga
why: Dva modula uvoze jedan drugoga (izravno ili kroz lanac). To je
petlja: Python ih ne može čisto učitati, a svaka izmjena jednoga
povlači drugi.
fix: Popravak: prekini petlju — premjesti zajednički dio u sloj koji
obje strane smiju uvoziti, da strelice idu samo u jednom smjeru.

en.title: foundation imports an upper layer (wrong direction)
why: `helpers/` is the foundation of the building — everyone may use it.
So it must not import from upper layers (`concrete/`, …), or the
foundation ends up depending on a floor that stands on top of it:
every change up there shakes the foundation, and in the worst case
you get an import loop.
fix: Fix: move the imported symbol down to a layer helpers may use,
or use a stdlib replacement inside helpers.

hr.title: temelj uvozi gornji sloj (pogrešan smjer)
why: `helpers/` je temelj zgrade — svi ga smiju koristiti. Zato ne smije
uvoziti iz gornjih slojeva (`concrete/`, …), inače temelj ovisi o
katu koji stoji na njemu: svaka izmjena gore trese temelj, a u
najgorem slučaju nastaje petlja uvoza.
fix: Popravak: spusti uvezeni simbol u sloj koji helpers smije koristiti,
ili upotrijebi stdlib zamjenu unutar helpersa.

en.title: import target is foundation material, but labelled as a domain
why: The imported package imports nothing from wattleflow itself — it is
a pure leaf (foundation material). The registry, however, lists it
as a domain (upper layer). The import is fine; the label is wrong.
fix: Fix: update the registry — remove the package from `domains` so the
tool treats it as foundation.

hr.title: cilj uvoza je temeljni materijal, a registar ga vodi kao domenu
why: Uvezeni paket ne uvozi ništa iz wattleflowa — čisti je list
(temeljni materijal). Registar ga ipak vodi kao domenu (gornji sloj).
Uvoz je u redu; oznaka je pogrešna.
fix: Popravak: ažuriraj registar — makni paket iz `domains` da ga alat
tretira kao temelj.

en.title: module skipped by the ORG rules — outside the distribution tier
why: This module imports a library outside the tier its distribution
declares, so the ORG-01/02/03 rules skipped it. Nothing here was
checked by those rules — clean is not the same as unmeasured.
Since v1.11.0 the same fact is ALSO raised as a K9 supply-chain
finding (NFRQ-SEC-03 criterion 1), so the skip is never silent.
fix: Not a defect to fix here: a declared blind spot, listed so the vector
never reads as full coverage. Act on the K9 finding instead.

hr.title: modul preskočen u ORG pravilima — izvan tiera distribucije
why: Modul uvozi biblioteku izvan tiera koji njegova distribucija
deklarira, pa su ga ORG-01/02/03 preskočili. Ta ga pravila nisu
provjerila — čisto nije isto što i nemjereno.
Od v1.11.0 ista se činjenica prijavljuje i kao K9 nalaz lanca
opskrbe (NFRQ-SEC-03 krit. 1), pa preskakanje više nije nijemo.
fix: Nije kvar za popravak ovdje: deklarirana slijepa pjega, navedena da
vektor nikad ne čita kao puna pokrivenost. Djeluj po K9 nalazu.

en.title: registry declares this as unmeasured by construction
why: The registry's `blind_spots` list names what the instrument cannot
see by design (not by accident). Declaring it is the requirement;
silence would be the defect.
fix: Nothing to do — carried into every report and every snapshot.

hr.title: registar ovo deklarira kao nemjereno po konstrukciji
why: `blind_spots` popis registra imenuje ono što instrument po dizajnu
ne može vidjeti (ne slučajno). Deklaracija je zahtjev; šutnja bi
bila kvar.
fix: Nema što raditi — nosi se u svaki nalaz i svaku snimku.

en.title: registry declares a rule this tool cannot check
why: The criterion lists a rule with a severity and a waiver policy, but
no code path can ever raise it. The declaration promises a verdict
the instrument never gives, so a green vector overstates coverage.
fix: Fix: implement the check, or retire the rule from the registry
through a DR — a rule is a promise, not a comment.

hr.title: registar deklarira pravilo koje alat ne može provjeriti
why: Kriterij navodi pravilo sa severityjem i waiver politikom, ali ga
nijedan put u kodu ne može dići. Deklaracija obećava presudu koju
instrument nikad ne daje, pa zeleni vektor precjenjuje pokrivenost.
fix: Popravak: implementiraj provjeru ili povuci pravilo iz registra
kroz DR — pravilo je obećanje, ne komentar.

en.title: tool emits a check the registry never declared
why: This check produces findings, yet the criterion does not list it.
Its severity and waiver therefore live in the tool instead of the
registry, outside the DR governance the criterion is meant to carry.
fix: Fix: declare the check in the registry `rules` block through a DR,
so its severity and waiver become a criterion fact.

hr.title: alat emitira provjeru koju registar nikad nije deklarirao
why: Provjera proizvodi nalaze, a kriterij je ne navodi. Njezin severity
i waiver time žive u alatu umjesto u registru, izvan DR upravljanja
koje kriterij treba nositi.
fix: Popravak: deklariraj provjeru u `rules` bloku registra kroz DR, da
joj severity i waiver postanu činjenica kriterija.

en.title: import outside the distribution tier (supply chain)
why: A module's home distribution is fixed by its import closure, not by
its role: importing a library outside the declared tier moves it out
of this distribution. A lazy, in-function import counts exactly like
a module-level one (DR-WFL-002 §2.1).
Until v1.11.0 this fact only removed the module from the ORG rules;
NFRQ-SEC-03 requires it to be REPORTED, because a shared third-party
dependency correlates breaches across every module that carries it.
fix: Fix: move the module to the distribution that owns the dependency,
hide the library behind a core abstraction, or — if the fallback is
functionally complete — declare it in `scope.guarded_optional` with
its DR reference (DR-WFL-003; the test is masking, not code review).

hr.title: uvoz izvan tiera distribucije (lanac opskrbe)
why: Matična distribucija modula određena je njegovim import-closureom, ne
ulogom: uvoz biblioteke izvan deklariranog tiera izmješta ga iz ove
distribucije. Lijeni uvoz unutar funkcije broji se jednako kao onaj
na razini modula (DR-WFL-002 §2.1).
Do v1.11.0 ta je činjenica samo micala modul iz ORG pravila; NFRQ-SEC-03
traži da se PRIJAVI, jer dijeljena third-party ovisnost korelira
proboje kroz sve module koji je nose.
fix: Popravak: premjesti modul u distribuciju koja je vlasnik ovisnosti,
sakrij biblioteku iza core apstrakcije, ili — ako je fallback
funkcionalno potpun — deklariraj ga u `scope.guarded_optional` s DR
referencom (DR-WFL-003; test je maskiranje, ne pregled koda).

en.title: registry declares a domain the tree does not contain
why: The criterion lists a top-level package that no module under --src
belongs to. Either the package moved to another distribution and the
criterion was not revised, or --src is mis-pointed. Both make the
vector overstate coverage: rules scoped to that domain measured
nothing at all, silently.
fix: Fix: remove the domain from the criterion through a DR, or point
--src at the tree that actually owns it.

hr.title: registar deklarira domenu koje u stablu nema
why: Kriterij navodi top-level paket kojem ne pripada nijedan modul pod
--src. Ili je paket preseljen u drugu distribuciju, a kriterij nije
revidiran, ili je --src krivo uperen. Oboje čini da vektor precjenjuje
pokrivenost: pravila vezana uz tu domenu nisu izmjerila ništa, nijemo.
fix: Popravak: makni domenu iz kriterija kroz DR, ili uperi --src na stablo
koje je doista njezin vlasnik.

en.title: packaging finds no packages — PEP 420 tree without `namespaces`
why: The tree is a PEP 420 namespace (no `__init__.py` at the root), but
the manifest configures `[tool.setuptools.packages.find]` without
`namespaces = true`. setuptools' finder then returns NOTHING, so the
built wheel ships no modules at all — while the source tree looks
perfectly healthy.
fix: Fix: set `namespaces = true` under [tool.setuptools.packages.find]
(proven in wattleflow-cad), then verify against the built wheel's
RECORD — the manifest is a claim until an artefact confirms it.

hr.title: pakiranje ne nalazi nijedan paket — PEP 420 stablo bez `namespaces`
why: Stablo je PEP 420 namespace (nema `__init__.py` u korijenu), a manifest
konfigurira `[tool.setuptools.packages.find]` bez `namespaces = true`.
setuptools tada ne nalazi NIŠTA, pa izgrađeni wheel ne isporučuje
nijedan modul — dok izvorno stablo izgleda posve zdravo.
fix: Popravak: postavi `namespaces = true` pod [tool.setuptools.packages.find]
(dokazano u wattleflow-cad), pa provjeri nad RECORD-om izgrađenog
wheela — manifest je tvrdnja dok je artefakt ne potvrdi.

en.title: class name is a bare generic role noun
why: `Parser`, `Manager`, `Router` on their own name a ROLE, not a thing:
the name says what the class does in the abstract and nothing about
layer, domain or responsibility. Two such classes in one system are
then indistinguishable by name, and the sign carries two meanings.
The same noun is perfectly legal once qualified.
fix: Fix: qualify it — `DriverS3UriParser`, not `Parser`; `CuttingSheet`,
not `Sheet`. Domain first, role last.

hr.title: ime klase je gola generička uloga-imenica
why: `Parser`, `Manager`, `Router` sami za sebe imenuju ULOGU, ne stvar:
ime kaže što klasa apstraktno radi, a ništa o sloju, domeni i
odgovornosti. Dvije takve klase u sustavu tada se po imenu ne
razlikuju, pa jedan znak nosi dva značenja.
Ista je imenica posve legalna čim je kvalificirana.
fix: Popravak: kvalificiraj je — `DriverS3UriParser`, ne `Parser`;
`CuttingSheet`, ne `Sheet`. Domena naprijed, uloga natrag.

en.title: pipeline name does not follow the declared grammar
why: A pipeline name is `Pipeline + <Subject> + <Operation|To<Target>> +
[Qualifier]`, and every facet comes from the criterion's controlled
vocabulary. The grammar makes the name predictable from the facets and
the facets recoverable from the name; the Subject leads because it
carries the most discriminating information and collocates a package's
classes together (NFRQ-ORG-02, Appendix A).
fix: Fix: rename to the grammar, or extend the vocabulary through a DR if
the missing token is legitimate. An unregistered token is a question
for the registry, not a licence for the name.

hr.title: ime pipelinea ne slijedi deklariranu gramatiku
why: Ime pipelinea je `Pipeline + <Subject> + <Operation|To<Target>> +
[Qualifier]`, a svaki facet dolazi iz kontroliranog vokabulara
kriterija. Gramatika čini ime predvidljivim iz faceta, a facete
obnovljivima iz imena; Subject vodi jer nosi najviše diskriminirajuće
informacije i kolocira klase istog paketa (NFRQ-ORG-02, Dodatak A).
fix: Popravak: preimenuj po gramatici, ili proširi vokabular kroz DR ako je
token legitiman. Neregistrirani token je pitanje za registar, ne
dozvola imenu.

en.title: TypeVar names a mechanism, not a role
why: A type variable must name the ROLE the type plays in the contract
(`Key`, `Value`, `Input`, `Output`), never the mechanism. A `T` or
`Type` suffix appears on every type variable, so it discriminates
nothing — zero information, pure noise. `T` alone is reserved for one
genuinely unconstrained parameter.
fix: Fix: rename to a role from the criterion's `type_vars.roles`; declare
variance through TypeVar(covariant=…), never through the name.

hr.title: TypeVar imenuje mehanizam, ne ulogu
why: Tipska varijabla mora imenovati ULOGU koju tip igra u ugovoru (`Key`,
`Value`, `Input`, `Output`), nikad mehanizam. Sufiks `T` ili `Type`
stoji na svakoj tipskoj varijabli pa ne razlikuje ništa — nula
informacije, čisti šum. Goli `T` rezerviran je za jedan doista
neograničen parametar.
fix: Popravak: preimenuj u ulogu iz `type_vars.roles` kriterija; varijancu
deklariraj kroz TypeVar(covariant=…), nikad imenom.

en.title: package exempt from the name grammar (declared, not forgotten)
why: The criterion lists this package as exempt: its names are deferred by
decision, not conforming. It is reported anyway, because an exemption
that stops being visible stops being reviewable — and its silent
disappearance must itself be a finding (D-11).
fix: Nothing to do here. Retire the exemption through a DR when the
deferred question (e.g. the named-entity cluster) is decided.

hr.title: paket izuzet od gramatike imena (deklarirano, ne zaboravljeno)
why: Kriterij ovaj paket vodi kao izuzet: njegova su imena odgođena
odlukom, ne usklađena. Ipak se prijavljuje, jer izuzeće koje prestane
biti vidljivo prestaje biti provjerljivo — a njegov tihi nestanak mora
i sam biti nalaz (D-11).
fix: Ovdje nema što raditi. Povuci izuzeće kroz DR kad odgođeno pitanje
(npr. klaster prepoznavanja entiteta) bude odlučeno.

en.title: package name is an abbreviation of its canonical subject
why: The subject facet must equal the owning package's canonical subject
(`dataframe`, not `dframe`; `text`, not `txt`), so that name and path
agree and one taxonomy serves both file navigation and reading. The
criterion maps the abbreviation for now and reports the gap.
fix: Fix: rename the package to its canonical subject and update the
imports in the same pass (hard rename, no long-lived aliases).

hr.title: ime paketa je kratica njegova kanonskog subjekta
why: Subject facet mora biti jednak kanonskom subjektu paketa koji ga
sadrži (`dataframe`, ne `dframe`; `text`, ne `txt`), da se ime i
putanja podudaraju i da jedna taksonomija služi i navigaciji i
čitanju. Kriterij zasad mapira kraticu i prijavljuje razliku.
fix: Popravak: preimenuj paket u kanonski subjekt i u istom prolazu
ažuriraj uvoze (hard rename, bez dugotrajnih aliasa).

en.title: acronym casing differs from the registered form
why: PEP 8 writes acronyms in full caps (`PDF`, not `Pdf`), and one
spelling per sign is what makes a name searchable. The decision
between the two conventions is open (DR-WFL-004), so this is reported
as evidence for that decision and deliberately does not fail a build:
enforcing one side of an undecided question is what the cascade forbids.
fix: Fix: nothing yet — the finding is input to the DR. Once it is taken,
the criterion's `acronym_identifier_casing.status` puts it in force.

hr.title: casing akronima razlikuje se od registriranog oblika
why: PEP 8 piše akronime velikim slovima (`PDF`, ne `Pdf`), a jedan zapis
po znaku je ono što ime čini pretraživim. Odluka između dviju
konvencija je otvorena (DR-WFL-004), pa se ovo prijavljuje kao građa
za tu odluku i namjerno ne ruši build: provođenje jedne strane
neodlučenog pitanja je ono što kaskada zabranjuje.
fix: Popravak: zasad nikakav — nalaz je ulaz u DR. Kad odluka padne,
`acronym_identifier_casing.status` kriterija stavlja pravilo na snagu.

en.title: manifest excludes a package this distribution's code imports
why: An `exclude` glob drops a package that modules in this very tree
import. The glob matches a NAME, not an owner, so a subtree this
distribution owns can be dropped together with the foreign subtree
the glob was written for. The wheel then imports what it does not ship.
fix: Fix: narrow the glob to the subtrees another distribution owns, or
re-include this one; every `wattleflow.*` subtree must have exactly
one owning distribution (NFRQ-SEC-03 criterion 2).

hr.title: manifest isključuje paket koji kod ove distribucije uvozi
why: `exclude` glob izbacuje paket koji moduli u ovom stablu uvoze. Glob
se veže na IME, ne na vlasnika, pa se podstablo u vlasništvu ove
distribucije izbaci zajedno sa stranim podstablom zbog kojeg je glob
napisan. Wheel tada uvozi ono što ne isporučuje.
fix: Popravak: suzi glob na podstabla koja su u vlasništvu druge
distribucije, ili ovo vrati natrag; svako `wattleflow.*` podstablo
mora imati točno jednog vlasnika (NFRQ-SEC-03 krit. 2).

en.title: preset whitelist declared under a non-canonical name
why: PresetDecorator resolves the permitted configuration keys from the
class attribute `ALLOWED`. Under any other spelling — `__allowed__`,
`__ALLOWED__`, `ALLOWED_KWARGS` — the resolution finds nothing, the
whitelist reads as empty, and every key the caller configures is
dropped silently: no exception, no log line, just defaults where the
operator expected their own values.
The class still LOOKS configured, which is what makes it costly.
fix: Fix: rename the attribute to `ALLOWED` and delete any `allowed=`
you were forwarding to super().__init__ — the base resolves it.

hr.title: popis dopuštenih ključeva deklariran pod nekanonskim imenom
why: PresetDecorator razrješava dopuštene ključeve iz razrednog atributa
`ALLOWED`. Pod bilo kojim drugim imenom — `__allowed__`,
`__ALLOWED__`, `ALLOWED_KWARGS` — razrješba ne nalazi ništa, popis
ostaje prazan, a svaka predana postavka tiho se odbacuje: bez iznimke,
bez zapisa, samo zadane vrijednosti ondje gdje je pogonitelj očekivao
svoje. Razred i dalje IZGLEDA podešeno — to ga i čini skupim.
fix: Popravak: preimenuj atribut u `ALLOWED` i ukloni `allowed=` koji si
prosljeđivao u super().__init__ — bazni razred ga sam razrješava.

en.title: preset whitelist declared at module scope
why: A module-level `ALLOWED` is invisible to `type(parent).ALLOWED`, so it
only works while some constructor keeps hand-carrying it — the moment
that plumbing is simplified away the whitelist silently empties.
It is also unreachable for a subclass, which cannot extend a list it
does not inherit.
fix: Fix: move the list into the class body. If two classes in the module
share it, let the second inherit or write `ALLOWED = First.ALLOWED + [...]`.

hr.title: popis dopuštenih ključeva deklariran na razini modula
why: `ALLOWED` na razini modula nevidljiv je za `type(parent).ALLOWED`, pa
radi samo dok ga neki konstruktor ručno prenosi — čim se ta cijev
pojednostavni, popis se tiho isprazni. Uz to je nedohvatljiv
nasljedniku, koji ne može proširiti popis koji nije naslijedio.
fix: Popravak: premjesti popis u tijelo razreda. Dijele li ga dva razreda
u modulu, neka drugi naslijedi ili napiše `ALLOWED = Prvi.ALLOWED + [...]`.

en.title: class declares ALLOWED and still forwards allowed= upward
why: The base resolves `ALLOWED` from the class, so forwarding it again is
a second copy of the same fact. Two copies drift: the declaration gets
a new key, the forwarded expression does not, and the class permits
less than it declares.
fix: Fix: drop the `allowed=` argument. Keep it only where the whitelist is
genuinely per-instance rather than per-class.

hr.title: razred deklarira ALLOWED i k tome ga prosljeđuje kroz allowed=
why: Bazni razred razrješava `ALLOWED` iz razreda, pa je ponovno
prosljeđivanje druga preslika iste činjenice. Dvije preslike se
razilaze: deklaracija dobije novi ključ, proslijeđeni izraz ne, i
razred dopušta manje nego što deklarira.
fix: Popravak: ukloni `allowed=`. Zadrži ga samo ondje gdje je popis
doista po primjerku, a ne po razredu.

en.title: module cannot be parsed — no rule could measure it
why: Every rule reads the same AST, so a file that does not parse is
skipped by all of them at once. Worse, the tier check saw an empty
import list and read it as `imports nothing foreign` — a broken
module used to pass as in-tier and clean.
Raised outside any rule, so no --select can hide the gap.
fix: Repair the syntax error, then re-run. Until then no statement about
this module is available — not a clean one either.

hr.title: modul se ne može parsirati — nijedno pravilo ga nije izmjerilo
why: Sva pravila čitaju isti AST, pa datoteku koja se ne parsira
preskaču odjednom. Gore: provjera tiera vidjela je prazan popis
uvoza i pročitala ga kao `ne uvozi ništa strano` — slomljen je
modul prolazio kao da je u tieru i čist.
Diže se izvan pravila, pa ga nijedan --select ne može sakriti.
fix: Popravi sintaktičku grešku pa ponovi run. Do tada o ovom modulu
nema nikakve tvrdnje — ni one da je čist.

en.title: rule severity is a word the tool cannot read
why: Severity belongs to the criterion, which is versioned apart from
the tool, precisely so a DR can change enforcement without touching
code. A word outside error/warning/info is silently replaced by the
tool's own default — so the level is decided by the instrument, on
exactly the rule the registry was trying to govern.
fix: Use error, warning or info in the `rules` block — or extend the
tool's LEVELS map through a DR if a new level is really wanted.

hr.title: severity pravila je riječ koju alat ne zna pročitati
why: Severity pripada kriteriju, koji se verzionira odvojeno od alata,
upravo zato da DR može promijeniti provedbu bez diranja koda.
Riječ izvan error/warning/info alat tiho zamijeni vlastitim
defaultom — pa razinu odlučuje instrument, i to na pravilu koje je
registar htio urediti.
fix: Koristi error, warning ili info u `rules` bloku — ili proširi
LEVELS tablicu alata kroz DR ako nova razina stvarno treba.

en.title: ERROR-level record in a branch that re-raises
why: A branch that wraps and re-raises has not handled the failure — the layer
above still has to. Logging error()/critical()/exception() there and raising
as well reports one cause twice; through strategy → repository → pipeline it
becomes three records and two tracebacks, all on the level that has to stay
quiet to remain readable.
fix: Fix: keep the context in the exception (error=, exc=, raise … from) and leave
a self.debug(step=Event.Failed.name, error=…) trace. The ERROR belongs to the
layer that stops the propagation.

hr.title: zapis ERROR razine u grani koja diže iznimku dalje
why: Grana koja omata i ponovno diže nije obradila kvar — odluku i dalje donosi
sloj iznad. Zapis error()/critical()/exception() uz raise prijavljuje isti
uzrok dvaput; kroz lanac strategija → repozitorij → pipeline to su tri zapisa
i dva tracebacka, na razini koja mora ostati tiha da bi bila čitljiva.
fix: Popravak: kontekst nosi iznimka (error=, exc=, raise … from), a grana ostavlja
trag self.debug(step=Event.Failed.name, error=…). ERROR pripada sloju koji
zaustavlja propagaciju.

en.title: branch re-raises without leaving a trace
why: The exception carries the cause upward, but nothing records that this layer
was on the path. With DEBUG on the step is still invisible — the one place
where local context (which document, which driver, which file) was free.
fix: Fix: add self.debug(msg=<operation>, step=Event.Failed.name, error=…) before
the raise. A bare `except X: raise` is exempt — the raiser already recorded it.

hr.title: grana diže iznimku bez traga
why: Iznimka nosi uzrok prema gore, ali nigdje nije zapisano da je i ovaj sloj bio
na putu. Uz uključen DEBUG korak ostaje nevidljiv — a upravo je tu lokalni
kontekst (koji dokument, koji driver, koja datoteka) bio besplatan.
fix: Popravak: dodaj self.debug(msg=<operacija>, step=Event.Failed.name, error=…)
prije dizanja. Goli `except X: raise` je izuzet — trag je već ostavio onaj
tko je iznimku podigao.

en.title: `msg` is not an Event member
why: A literal, an f-string or a local variable puts the event outside the
controlled vocabulary: the record can no longer be selected by facet, and the
same operation ends up spelled three ways across the framework. `.value` is
presentation and may change; `.name` is the identifier.
fix: Fix: msg=Event.<Member>.name. If no member fits, the vocabulary is short one
— that is a DR, not a literal.

hr.title: `msg` nije član Event-a
why: Literal, f-string ili lokalna varijabla izmiču događaj iz kontroliranog
vokabulara: zapis se više ne može odabrati po faseti, a ista operacija dobiva
tri različita zapisa kroz framework. `.value` je prikaz i smije se mijenjati;
`.name` je identifikator.
fix: Popravak: msg=Event.<Član>.name. Ako nijedan član ne odgovara, rječniku
nedostaje član — to je DR, ne literal.

en.title: `step` is not a phase member
why: The phase axis only sorts if it draws from one closed set. A free literal or a
non-phase member (Configuration, Iterating) makes 'entry vs exit vs failure'
unanswerable by a filter.
fix: Fix: use Started, Starting, Validating, Configuring, Check, Completing,
Completed or Failed, spelled with .name.

hr.title: `step` nije fazni član
why: Fazna os sortira samo ako crpi iz jednog zatvorenog skupa. Slobodni literal
ili ne-fazni član (Configuration, Iterating) čini pitanje ulaz/izlaz/kvar
neodgovorivim filtrom.
fix: Popravak: koristi Started, Starting, Validating, Configuring, Check,
Completing, Completed ili Failed, zapisano s .name.

en.title: caller kwargs splatted into an audit call
why: The caller's keys land in the same namespace as the audit call's own. A key
named msg raises TypeError; exc_info, extra or stacklevel silently become
control arguments — the name of a data key changes behaviour.
fix: Fix: pass the dict as one value (kwargs=kwargs) or name the fields you mean.

hr.title: pozivateljev rječnik raspakiran u audit poziv
why: Pozivateljevi ključevi ulaze u isti imenski prostor kao i argumenti samog
poziva. Ključ msg diže TypeError; exc_info, extra ili stacklevel tiho postaju
upravljački argumenti — ime podatkovnog ključa mijenja ponašanje.
fix: Popravak: predaj rječnik kao jednu vrijednost (kwargs=kwargs) ili imenuj polja
koja stvarno misliš.

en.title: INFO emitted by a step class
why: A strategy, driver or connection runs inside one unit of work. An INFO per
call scales with the input, not with the job: 2000 attachments give 2000 INFO
records for one task, and the level that answers 'is the job done' stops
answering it.
fix: Fix: drop to debug(), and let the owner of the unit (pipeline, processor,
orchestrator) emit one INFO with counters. A class that IS a unit declares
itself in the registry under audit.info_exempt.

hr.title: INFO iz klase koja je korak
why: Strategija, driver ili konekcija izvode se unutar jedne jedinice posla. INFO
po pozivu skalira s ulazom, ne s poslom: 2000 privitaka daje 2000 INFO zapisa
za jedan posao, pa razina koja odgovara je li posao gotov prestaje odgovarati.
fix: Popravak: spusti na debug(), a jedan INFO s brojačima neka emitira vlasnik
jedinice (pipeline, procesor, orkestrator). Klasa koja JEST jedinica deklarira
se u registru pod audit.info_exempt.

en.title: shared helper nothing outside the shelf uses
why: `helpers/` is the shared shelf: it holds things that other packages use.
A module no package outside the shelf imports is not shelf material —
it belongs beside its consumer, or it is dead weight nobody carries.
fix: Fix: move the module next to the package that uses it, or delete it if
nothing does. Check the sibling distribution first — its imports are
outside --src, so the count here is a lower bound (DR-WFL-019).

hr.title: dijeljeni helper koji izvan police nitko ne koristi
why: `helpers/` je dijeljena polica: drži ono što koriste drugi paketi.
Modul koji ne uvozi nijedan paket izvan police nije materijal za policu —
pripada uz svog potrošača ili je mrtav teret.
fix: Popravak: premjesti modul uz paket koji ga koristi, ili ga obriši ako ga
nitko ne koristi. Prvo provjeri sestrinsku distribuciju — njezini uvozi su
izvan --src, pa je brojka ovdje donja granica (DR-WFL-019).

en.title: shelf usage, stated as a statistic
why: This distribution's `helpers/` serves consumers that ship elsewhere, so a
module unused here is usually used there. Counting it as a defect per module
would report the measurement scope, not the code — the criterion therefore
states one number and leaves the verdict to the distribution that owns the
consumers.
fix: Nothing to fix from this line alone. Read it as coverage: how much of the
shelf this tree actually uses.

hr.title: iskorištenost police, iskazana kao statistika
why: `helpers/` ove distribucije opslužuje potrošače koji se isporučuju drugdje,
pa je modul koji je ovdje neiskorišten obično iskorišten ondje. Brojati to
kao prekršaj po modulu značilo bi prijaviti opseg mjerenja, a ne kod — zato
kriterij iskazuje jedan broj, a presudu ostavlja distribuciji koja posjeduje
potrošače.
fix: Iz ovog retka se ništa ne popravlja. Čitaj ga kao pokrivenost: koliko police
ovo stablo doista koristi.
